# pypdfium2 5.14.0 notices

Copied verbatim from the installed pypdfium2 5.14.0 Linux x86-64 wheel's
`dist-info/licenses` directory. `LICENSES/` contains the binding/documentation
licenses; `linux-x64/` retains the wheel's PDFium and native dependency notices.
These notices apply to that wheel; other platform builds require their own
corresponding notices. No native binary is bundled here.
